fusions.name: Long-Stride Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunging strike that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Dust Flick
fusions.desc: Kicks a cone of grit 4 tiles ahead that deals 10 earth damage to everything in it, knocks each back 2 tiles and leaves them [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 12 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
